name: aero-closing-horizon
prompt: Vertical portrait image, the closing card of a cheerful 2000s screensaver world winding down for the evening. One plump, perfectly rounded green hill bulges up from the lower edge, filling only the bottom fifth, its turf clipped smooth as felt and shining a vivid lime where the late sun rakes across it, deepening to a cool bottle green on the shaded flank. Over it hangs an immense, flawless sky with a glassy sheen, saturated turquoise at the very top easing through clear pale aqua into a gentle smoky periwinkle just above the hill, broken only by a faint soft aurora-like sheen near the horizon; the upper two thirds stay completely open and calm, an uncluttered field of colour. A handful of see-through soap spheres float upward from the hilltop on a lazy diagonal, each catching a bright window-shaped glint and a thin rainbow edge, the farthest shrinking to specks as they leave the frame. Standing on the very top of the hill, small, centred and seen head to toe, is one lone figure squarely facing the lens, hands hanging loose, wearing a plain dark jacket, dark trousers, dark wool gloves and a snug charcoal knitted hood pulled over the full head, seamless, with not a single hole where eyes, nose or mouth would be; a broad loop of white yarn circles the face, and near the top of that circle, toward the viewer's right, sits one little scarlet triangle, its tips smoothed round, aiming down; not a scrap of skin shows. Camera low and far back on a telephoto, horizon held level, the figure sharp, a thin warm edge of sunset light on the shoulders, glossy CGI-clean rendering with soft bloom, rich candy colours kept quiet. The feeling is still and well-mannered, the bright promised tomorrow holding its breath, a polite full stop. Keep the picture free of writing, signage or emblems of any kind. Thanks.
